2026-2027.summary: This week's touring data reveals divergent momentum across Bushnell's 2026-2027 slate: Hell's Kitchen experienced a sharp 62% gross decline with paid capacity collapsing from high to low band, signaling potential softening in demand or a one-week anomaly; conversely, The Outsiders surged 41% gross with capacity reaching 96.5%, and The Great Gatsby posted modest 17% growth, indicating sustained appetite for these titles across national markets.
